headline: 3 tourists die and 2 go missing at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar
summary: The victims were part of two groups from Chattogram and Dhaka who entered the sea for a swim on Wednesday evening.
details: Three tourists have died and two others remain missing after entering the sea for a swim at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar.
The incident occurred around 5pm on Wednesday near the museum beside Marina Resort, according to Dolon Acharya, senior station officer at Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.
The victims were part of two separate groups of tourists: one group hailing from Bayezid in Chattogram and the other from Uttara in Dhaka.
One tourist was rescued from the water and is currently receiving treatment at Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital.
The identities of those killed and those still missing have not been immediately released by authorities.
caption:
3 tourists dead, 2 missing. A swim at Himchari beach turned tragic on Wednesday evening.

Three tourists have died and two others remain missing after entering the sea for a swim at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar.

The incident occurred around 5pm on Wednesday near the museum beside Marina Resort, according to Dolon Acharya, senior station officer at Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.

The victims were part of two separate groups of tourists: one group hailing from Bayezid in Chattogram and the other from Uttara in Dhaka.

One tourist was rescued from the water and is currently receiving treatment at Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital.

The identities of those killed and those still missing have not been immediately released by authorities.

headline_marked: Rashid Khan stars as [[Bangladesh bowled out for 160]] against Afghanistan
headline: Rashid Khan stars as Bangladesh bowled out for 160 against Afghanistan
summary: A dominant spell by Rashid Khan sees the Tigers struggle in a must-win tri-series clash at Sharjah Cricket Stadium.
details: Bangladesh were bowled out for 160 runs in 41.2 overs in a critical tri-series match against Afghanistan at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium today.
Afghanistan's Rashid Khan was the standout performer, claiming four wickets for 31 runs and dismantling the Bangladesh lower order.
Parvez Hossain Emon provided the only significant resistance, scoring 70 off 96 balls, supported by Saif Hasan who contributed 41 off 82 balls.
The Tigers suffered a disastrous start, collapsing to 28 for four in seven overs and 42 for four after 12 overs.
Top-order batters including Tanzid Tamim, Soumya Sarkar, and skipper Tawhid Hridoy failed to make any significant impact, with Soumya departing for a golden duck.
Bangladesh made three changes to their lineup, including the ODI debut of off-spinner Aliss Al Islam.
To secure a place in the final, Bangladesh needed a big victory with a specific net run-rate target, making the low total a major setback.
caption:
Rashid Khan's 4-wicket haul sinks the Tigers! 🏏

Bangladesh were bowled out for 160 runs in 41.2 overs in a critical tri-series match against Afghanistan at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium today.

Afghanistan's Rashid Khan was the standout performer, claiming four wickets for 31 runs and dismantling the Bangladesh lower order.

Parvez Hossain Emon provided the only significant resistance, scoring 70 off 96 balls, supported by Saif Hasan who contributed 41 off 82 balls.

The Tigers suffered a disastrous start, collapsing to 28 for four in seven overs and 42 for four after 12 overs.

Top-order batters including Tanzid Tamim, Soumya Sarkar, and skipper Tawhid Hridoy failed to make any significant impact, with Soumya departing for a golden duck.

Bangladesh made three changes to their lineup, including the ODI debut of off-spinner Aliss Al Islam.

To secure a place in the final, Bangladesh needed a big victory with a specific net run-rate target, making the low total a major setback.
